description: Use this to list or filter Las Vegas work spots by explicit criteria (zone, category, Wi-Fi, outlets, quiet, calls, open now / at a time, near a point) or by name/keyword. Returns compact rows: name, category, area, hours, Wi-Fi/outlets/noise/calls, and the spot's slug and url. For "what's best for me" questions prefer recommend_spot; for one place's full details call get_spot with the slug.

category.description: Coffee, Library, Hotel lobby, Lounge, Cowork, Other

open_at.description: Open at a time: ISO datetime (no offset = Vegas local) or "sat 14:00"

open_now.description: true = only spots open right now (Las Vegas time)

q.description: Free text: name, neighborhood or vibe, e.g. "matcha", "arts district", "Pop Cafe"

wifi.description: true = only spots with good Wi-Fi

zone.description: Zone slug, name or alias: a quadrant (central, northwest, northeast, southwest, southeast), an area (e.g. the-strip, downtown, arts-district, chinatown, summerlin, henderson) or a landmark waypoint. See list_zones.

name: search_spots
title: Search and filter Las Vegas work spots
